# Best MagSafe car mounts (Qi2)

**Best for most iPhone drivers: Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W Vent Mount, $47.99**
- Three of the roundups pick it as best overall. It includes a 27W car adapter and a 1 m USB-C cable, and it rotates between portrait and landscape.
- Check your vents first. Belkin's documentation says slats should be no more than 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep, and vertical slats may shift or droop. A Belkin vent/dash version exists for awkward vents.
- Sources: [RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)

**Fastest and most reliable: Anker Prime MagGo AirCool (A2933), $89.99 list**
- It's Qi2 25W with thermoelectric cooling plus a fan. [MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/) uses it as their daily driver, and [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/) lists it at $69.99 on sale.
- It needs a 45W+ USB-C car adapter for full speed. Gadgeteer and MountGuys say a 60W adapter is in the box, while the other roundups don't mention one, so confirm on the listing.
- It doesn't fit Tesla or Mercedes-Benz vehicles, or cars without vent blades.
- Only the iPhone 17 and 16 Pro Max/Plus get the full 25W. The iPhone 16 and 16 Pro get up to 22W, and the iPhone 15 and earlier get about 15W.

**Best value with cooling: ESR HaloLock 15W with CryoBoost**
- It's Qi2-certified at 15W with a fan, and it mounts on a vent or the dash.
- ESR lists it at $39.99, and the Dealectric page says code PARTNER18 brought it to $32.80 when tested on 2026-10-22. The code expires 2026-12-31, and checkout has the final word.
- Buy: [ESR HaloLock CryoBoost at ESR's US store](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you.
- Prices vary by source. Gadgeteer lists $35.99 in its summary and $18.99 in its text, and says the car adapter isn't included. The Dealectric page doesn't say either way.

**Budget pick: LISEN 15W Qi2 mount, about $16–27**
- It's a dash and vent combo that appears in the roundups' Amazon product lists. Gadgeteer's top pick is a different LISEN model, the Qi2.2 25W with a fan, from $39.95 with a 95W adapter included.
- You'll need a charger that supplies at least 18W per port.

## Choosing
- **Standard iPhone, simple setup:** Belkin.
- **iPhone 16/17, hot climate, heavy navigation:** Anker Prime, or LISEN's fan model if you want to spend less.
- **Cheapest cooled option:** ESR CryoBoost.
- **Phone keeps sliding or drooping:** a dash or suction mount, or a bolt-down mount for trucks, is steadier than a vent clip, per MountGuys.
- **Android:** you need a magnetic Qi2 or MagSafe-compatible case, except phones with built-in Qi2 magnets, such as the Pixel 10 series per [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-magsafe-wireless-chargers/).

The search results didn't give direct purchase links for Belkin or Anker, and I can't browse to find them. The review pages above have the Amazon buttons, or you can search the exact product names.

If you tell me your phone model and whether your vents are horizontal or vertical, I can narrow it to one pick.
